answer: Every wallet's send speed is capped by a bond that only grows with age. A newborn agent may move $40 a day; a two-year-old wallet holding $120k of unslashed bond may push $2,000 an hour. A sybil farm flooding the ledger with 400 fresh wallets still nets $16k a day; to move $1M it must pre-fund $150k of bond and wait 90 days, by which time the flash run is over. A peer-flagged velocity spike slashes 20% of the bond, ratcheting the cap down. The bond is a lantern only patient wallets can carry: honest traders never feel the quill, while a fresh bot fleet wanders the dock and drowns at low tide.
